context.content_translation:
Trannelin Industries的高管团队正在确定哪些部门明年将转移到西海岸。
A. any
B. none
C. each
D. which

items.question: The executive team of Trannelin Industries ality to is determining ------- divisions will transfer to the West Coast next year.
